source.title: Antithrombotic therapy for ambulatory patients with multiple myeloma receiving immunomodulatory agents.

scope: Read all54 physical pages of exact secondary antithrombotic review for ambulatory multiple myeloma receiving immunomodulatory agents. Verify search cutoff, trials/reports/unique participants, included treatment regimens/prophylaxis route/dose/time and exclusions. Extract bounded aspirin comparator-specific outcomes and mortality, symptomatic/asymptomatic VTE, DVT/PE, major/minor/clinically-relevant bleeding/adverse events if reported, with event Ns, comparison direction, uncertainty and source-reported certainty. Other anticoagulant comparisons remain explicit context, not independent aspirin efficacy. No anticancer or established-VTE treatment inference.
